title: Quarantine: Taiwan under customs inspection
oneLine: In this scenario China's coast guard starts 'inspecting' every ship bound for Taiwan: not a blockade on paper, but an island with days of gas can feel it fast.

whoIsWho.stance: Taiwan's president; must keep energy flowing without firing first, with a hostile legislature.
Wants Taipei to bend without a war, while his high command is thinned by purges.
Navy already busy blockading Iran; values his trade truce with Beijing.
Said a Taiwan attack could threaten Japan's survival; Beijing has punished Japan since.
Taiwan's opposition; cut the defence budget and favours talks with Beijing.

whyItMatters: Taiwan makes most of the world's advanced chips and imports about 97% of its energy. A coast guard squeeze could choke it without a shot, forcing Washington and Tokyo to choose between escalation and backing down.

timeline.text: Defeated Nationalists retreat to Taiwan; Beijing has claimed it ever since.
China holds its largest drills around Taiwan after a US House Speaker visits.
Lai Ching-te becomes president; the opposition controls the legislature.
Japan's Takaichi links a Taiwan crisis to Japan's survival; Beijing retaliates.
Justice Mission-2025 drills rehearse sealing off Keelung and Kaohsiung.
Legislature cuts Lai's special defence budget by about 38%.
After a Beijing summit, Trump warns Taipei against independence.
